title: Pearl INT certificate-v3 runtime byte-path reconstruction and non-self-mined hash_b gate
question: For the pinned dense INT certificate-v3 lineage only, can public checkpoint bytes, transformed through the pinned Pearl/vLLM runtime path without miner-provided operand bytes, reproduce hash_b in one future-selected, finalized, non-self-mined Pearl mainnet block?

frozen_inputs.value: Pearl dense INT certificate-v3; excludes V1/V2, MoE, and proposed FP8 certificate-v4
node/wire/certificate_v3.go -> node/zkpow/verify.go -> zk-pow/src/ffi -> zk-pow/src/api + zk-pow/src/circuit; SeedDerivation::Salted; zk-pow/src/v1 excluded
excluded by mainnet consensus at the pin; a V3 candidate-lane artifact with non-dense public data is consensus-contradictory
>=100 confirmations at two independent public sources agreeing on block hash

procedure: Phase 1 — raw-source retention: verify and digest the pinned Pearl checkout and retain the vLLM 0.20.2 source at commit bc150f50299199599673614f80d12a196f377655; record every load-bearing file digest.

Phase 2 — checkpoint/registry freeze: freeze repository identities, immutable revisions, file digests, tensor lists, TP degree set, provenance receipts, and trust tier T1 or better; commit no model-weight bytes.
Phase 3 — transformation-recipe freeze: fix every checkpoint-to-runtime parameter with pinned source file:line; any unresolved fusion, slice, layout, dtype, or contiguity rule emits BLOCKED.

Phase 4 — implementation/version freeze: freeze two code-path-independent Aeye implementations, their source digests and toolchains, and one replay command; they share no Aeye parser, transform, hashing orchestration, comparison helper, or fixture generator.

Phase 5 — known-bad tests: require E000-KB-01 through E000-KB-30 to produce their fixed diagnostics in both Aeye implementations and the Pearl oracle where applicable; official keyed-BLAKE3 and Salted seed vectors are positive parity controls.

Phase 6 — reviewer readback and operator acceptance: obtain a fresh reviewer-owned freeze and source-bound readback of Phases 1–5, then retain an operator record citing the SHA-256 values of this manifest, the reviewer artifacts, registry, recipe, both implementation trees and toolchains, and the complete control matrix; its UTC time is T_accept.

Phase 7 — candidate selection and sealed computation: apply reviewer-freeze.json#candidate_selection_rule to the future chain, retain two-source eligibility and consensus-drift evidence, write public_data[84:116] to a sealed file without displaying or comparing it, record only its sealing digest, enumerate every frozen registry slab of candidate shape (n,k), and compute full independent transcripts before reveal.

Phase 8 — reveal: open the sealed hash_b once, record the UTC reveal time and verify the sealing digest; after this point no registry, recipe, parser, implementation, or fixture change is permitted for E-000.

Phase 9 — exactly one comparison: compare the revealed hash_b once against the exhaustively enumerated candidate-root set and emit exactly one terminal state under precedence INVALID > BLOCKED > UNRETRIEVED > OUT_OF_COVERAGE > MATCH > IN_COVERAGE_NO_MATCH.
acceptance: The operator acceptance record predates the candidate, follows completion and fresh reviewer readback of Phases 1–5, and cites the exact SHA-256 values of this manifest, reviewer artifacts, registry, recipe, both implementation trees and toolchains, and the complete control matrix.
The V3 path is parsed through zk-pow/src/api with SeedDerivation::Salted; no zk-pow/src/v1 parser or circuit semantics enter the run.

The selected candidate satisfies the fixed future-block rule, two-source block-hash agreement, at least 100 confirmations at both sources, dense 164-byte public data, the consensus-drift check, and the retained non-self-mining attestation.

The registry is frozen at T1 or better before candidate selection, every checkpoint byte used matches its frozen digest, and every runtime transformation parameter is fixed from pinned public source evidence.

Two code-path-independent implementations agree byte-for-byte on header_76, mining_config_52, job_key, source-tensor digests, slab digest and shape, padded length, leaf count, and root; equal roots with any divergent intermediate make the run INVALID.

The pinned Pearl oracle agrees on the protocol stages it can adjudicate—header/config serialization, job_key, padding, leaf count, and root—without being misrepresented as an independent checkpoint parser or vLLM transformation implementation.
All 30 retained controls produce their fixed outcomes before the candidate is selected; hash_b is sealed before candidate-root computation, revealed once, and compared once.

A pinned native Pearl V3 certificate-verifier result is retained as a separate qualification field. Rejection makes the candidate INVALID and verifier unavailability makes the run BLOCKED; acceptance does not enlarge E-000's hash_b-only claim or silently satisfy an Aeye coordinate.

MATCH means only that the selected block's hash_b opened to one or more registered runtime weight byte-strings. It never means full inference, valid activations, model identity beyond those bytes, useful work, hardware origin, or DEMAND.

A plausible Pearl weakness stops the run as BLOCKED with E000-BLK-SECURITY-STOP; only a minimal local reproduction is retained outside public artifacts, no vulnerability detail enters any public artifact, and disclosure follows Pearl's SECURITY.md with an operator decision.
failure: Any hash_b read, display, log, comparison, or target-dependent choice before Phase 8 makes E-000 INVALID.
Any registry, recipe, parser, implementation, or fixture change after Phase 8 makes E-000 INVALID; a correction requires E-000-R2 with a new freeze while preserving E-000.

Any version-route mismatch, unresolved runtime transform parameter, inability to establish registry retrieval before T_accept, registry below T1, failed oracle parity, consensus drift, or unavailable native verifier makes the experiment BLOCKED and is never optimized away.
Miner-captured or runtime-captured operand bytes fail the public-reconstruction hypothesis and make the run INVALID.
UNRETRIEVED and OUT_OF_COVERAGE remain distinct from a mismatch. IN_COVERAGE_NO_MATCH is legal only after exhaustive pre-reveal enumeration of every frozen slab of the candidate shape.

A mismatch is retained without editing the registry or recipe and is phrased only as 'did not open to any registered slab'; it is never called random, non-model, false work, or network-wide falsification.
Any V1, V2, MoE certificate, FP8 certificate-v4 material, or incompatible runtime path is outside this dense V3 experiment and cannot discharge it.
known_bad_controls: E000-KB-01 — reject legacy V1 fixed-body parsing in the V3 lane with E000-REJ-VERSION-ROUTE.
E000-KB-02 — reject a V2 version field with E000-REJ-VERSION-ROUTE.
E000-KB-03 — reject proposed V4/FP8 material with E000-REJ-VERSION-ROUTE.
E000-KB-04 — reject any V3 PublicDataLen other than 164 in this dense lane with E000-REJ-PUBLIC-DATA-LENGTH.
E000-KB-05 — reject consistently encoded 163-byte and 165-byte public data with E000-REJ-PUBLIC-DATA-LENGTH.
E000-KB-06 — reject a corrupted certificate block hash with E000-REJ-BLOCK-HASH-BINDING.
E000-KB-07 — reject a corrupted or version-2-domain proof commitment with E000-REJ-PROOF-COMMITMENT.
E000-KB-08 — detect an unfused checkpoint tensor where the recipe fuses with E000-DIV-SLAB-DIGEST.
E000-KB-09 — detect permuted Q/K/V fusion order with E000-DIV-SLAB-DIGEST.
E000-KB-10 — detect swapped gate/up fusion order with E000-DIV-SLAB-DIGEST.
E000-KB-11 — detect a wrong TP rank or degree with E000-DIV-SLAB-DIGEST.
E000-KB-12 — reject any EP or expert-stacking artifact in the dense lane with E000-REJ-MOE-OUT-OF-SCOPE.
E000-KB-13 — detect an n-by-k slab transposed to k-by-n with E000-DIV-SLAB-DIGEST.
E000-KB-14 — detect Fortran-ordered or non-contiguous layout with E000-DIV-SLAB-DIGEST.
E000-KB-15 — detect any signed-byte encoding other than two's-complement modulo 256 with E000-DIV-SLAB-DIGEST.
E000-KB-16 — detect a changed leaf count or shape/byte-length inconsistency with E000-DIV-LEAF-COUNT.
E000-KB-17 — detect omitted, doubled, per-row, or wrong-granularity padding with E000-DIV-ROOT.
E000-KB-18 — detect unkeyed or derive-key BLAKE3 with E000-DIV-ROOT.
E000-KB-19 — detect a one-bit job_key mutation with E000-DIV-ROOT.
E000-KB-20 — detect exactly one reversal of header hash byte order with E000-DIV-JOB-KEY; pinned Pearl is the cancelling-error tie-breaker.
E000-KB-21 — detect big-endian header scalars or swapped timestamp/nbits with E000-DIV-JOB-KEY.
E000-KB-22 — reject non-zero config trailer bytes, e != 0, mma_type != 0, or a non-52-byte config with E000-REJ-MINING-CONFIG.
E000-KB-23 — reject Legacy rather than Salted V3 noise-seed derivation with E000-REJ-SEED-DERIVATION; this control applies only to the commitment_hash/noise-seed vector and does not test hash_b.
E000-KB-24 — reject a registry revision lacking a retrieval receipt before T_accept with E000-REJ-REGISTRY-TEMPORAL.
E000-KB-25 — reject miner- or runtime-captured tensor bytes as checkpoint evidence with E000-REJ-PROVENANCE.

E000-KB-26 — a poisoned registry identity with correct bytes must propagate a false identity beside a byte-level MATCH and emit E000-PROPAGATE-FALSE-MATCH; this tests a declared limitation, not detection.
E000-KB-27 — reject comparing hash_a where hash_b is claimed with E000-REJ-FIELD-SELECTION.
E000-KB-28 — block any recipe with an unresolved parameter rather than substituting a default, with E000-BLK-UNRESOLVED-TRANSFORM.
E000-KB-29 — equal final roots with any divergent intermediate invalidate the transcript with E000-INV-TRANSCRIPT-DIVERGENCE.
E000-KB-30 — official keyed-BLAKE3 vectors and pinned V3 Salted seed vectors must pass Pearl-oracle parity; any failure emits E000-ORACLE-PARITY and blocks candidate selection.
blocking_conditions: ADR-0012 is incorporated in this manifest's procedure order, but this corrected manifest has not received a fresh reviewer-owned freeze and source-bound readback and therefore cannot be used for T_accept.

The predecessor reviewer freeze and AMENDMENTS_CONFIRMED readback remain historical evidence only; E-000 remains blocked until new reviewer artifacts bind this corrected manifest and every pre-candidate gate is complete.

At freeze creation the PAB note still cited the legacy zk-pow/src/v1 route. The source-bound readback independently checked the owner correction to zk-pow/src/api + circuit + ffi; this historical condition is resolved and does not constitute operator acceptance.
BLOCKED and INVALID were absent from the pre-freeze manifest classification set; this amendment adds them, but the state-machine implementation and fixtures are not yet independently reviewed.
No T1 checkpoint registry predating T_accept and no complete pinned runtime transformation recipe have yet been frozen.
No pair of implementations meeting the strict code-path-independence rule and no complete 30-control matrix have yet been retained.
No future-selected finalized candidate may be inspected until the preceding gates are complete; candidate hash, height, certificate, and hash_b intentionally remain absent.
